view_meta: The credential engine — sync sources & drift with Sync now/Configure, the native mapping rules, reach coverage, and the resolution audit (authN metadata only, no secrets · TG-107/TG-109).
purpose: CREDENTIALS surface (configuration domain, epic TG-107; write half TG-109): the operator window onto the credential engine, rendered LIVE from /v1/credentials/{sources,coverage,resolutions,native} (spec/006 REQ-526; spec/016 REQ-1615/1618). Four honest sections — (1) sync sources: one row per source with plane badge, published precedence rank ('unpublished' when the projection predates it — never 0-as-rank), ok/partial/failed outcome chip, relative last-synced, added/changed/removed drift, covered-target count, non-secret err text, and per-source actions: Sync now (POST the worker lane; the outcome renders VERBATIM incl. the starved sentence; 502 = 'could not be run — not a verdict on the source'; 401 = the shared admin step-up, nothing auto-submits) and Configure (the EXISTING generated module dialog via modCfgCard; the inline/native sources render 'no dialog (inline/native source)' honestly); (1b) native mapping: the operator-authored native-db rules at the elevated trace-read tier (a plain session's 403 renders the honest elevated-read state + step-up affordance), with ledger-first add (entry + rationale, validator text verbatim) and per-row delete (rationale prompt; a 404 renders 'already removed'); SecretRef fields render as reference STRINGS only (INV-13), no control resolves a value; (2) coverage — 'what can TG reach?': per-plane and per-source resolved/ambiguous/unresolved stacked bars + tallies over the window, plus recent-resolved vs recent-refused frontier lists; (3) resolution log: the per-target audit table (target/plane/outcome/source/user/scheme/key-ref-scheme/time) with a debounced ?target= search box and ?limit= respected.
notes: Honesty contract: NO fixture — every value is fetched live at session adoption. Unauthenticated shows only the auth gate; authenticated, an unavailable endpoint (503 fail-closed) renders an honest error state and an empty spine an honest empty state, never a fabricated row (INV-15). Sealed values never appear (INV-13): the payload carries only non-secret metadata (schemes, login users, reference schemes env/file/store/vault/bao) and the surface has no control that requests or displays key material. Reuses the console design system verbatim: chip-ok/chip-warn/chip-bad outcome semantics, the map-vs-territory plane language (machine=indigo, human=steel), wrapcard/tbl/sec/empty components, and the same theme tokens — no new palette. Tables live in their own overflow-x:auto container so the page body never scrolls sideways. Live state (liveState.credSources/credCoverage/credResolutions) is populated by modules/_live/js.txt liveAdopt(); the resolution search re-fetches and re-renders in place, restoring caret focus like the knowledge surface.
verified: assemble.py rebuild byte-clean; node --check on the extracted bundle passes; hash-route #credentials registers and the four sections render (loading/empty/error states exercised against a stubbed API); the write half is oracle-driven by deploy/console/v2/e2e/credentials-write.mjs (one POST per Sync-now click, starved sentence verbatim, native 403 elevated-read state, validator 400 verbatim, precedence 'unpublished' honesty, no-dialog honesty).
